name.es: Alborada de la Estrella del Alba y la Luna

fourPiece.en: When the equipping character is off-field, Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 20%. When the party's Moonsign Level is at least Ascendant Gleam, Lunar Reaction DMG will be further increased by 40%. This effect will disappear after the equipping character is active for 3s.
fourPiece.es: Cuando el portador de este conjunto está en tu equipo pero no en uso, el daño de Reacción Lunar que inflige aumenta en un 20%. Cuando el nivel de presagio lunar del equipo es de, al menos, resplandor ascendente, el daño de Reacción Lunar aumenta en un 40% adicional. Estos efectos se anularán después de que el portador de este conjunto permanezca en el campo de batalla durante 3 s.

role.en: High Energy Requirement Off-Field DPS & Buff Support
role.es: DPS fuera de campo con altos requisitos de energía y soporte de buffs

notes.en: Columbina blesses her team with a large buff to Lunar reactions, while also inflicting good amounts of Lunar damage herself, mimicking whatever lunar reaction is dominant in your team. Starting at [C1], Columbina should use her Burst before her Skill so the extra Gravity Interference triggered by C1 will be buffed by her Burst.
notes.es: Colombina blesses her team with a large buff to Lunar reactions, while also inflicting good amounts of Lunar damage herself, mimicking whatever lunar reaction is dominant in your team. Starting at [C1], Colombina should use her Habilidad definitiva before her Habilidad Elemental so the extra Gravity Interference triggered by C1 will be buffed by her Habilidad definitiva.

role.es: DPS fuera de campo y soporte de buffs y escudos

notes.en: Ineffa transforms all instances of the Electro-Charged reaction into Lunar-Charged while she's in the team, which has its own scalings and can even crit. Both her Skill and Burst deploy her robot companion, Birgitta, to the field, who can deal damage and apply Electro while off-field. Additionally, Ineffa's Skill can also provide a shield. Her Burst also provides an Elemental Mastery buff based on a portion of Ineffa's ATK (her A4 talent). Birgitta stays on-field longer than both of Ineffa's Skill and Burst individual cooldowns, meaning that Birgitta has 100% field uptime.
notes.es: Ineffa transforms all instances of the electrocargado lunar reaction into electrocargado lunar while she's in the team, which has its own scalings and can even crit. Both her Habilidad Elemental and Habilidad definitiva deploy her robot companion, Birgitta, to the field, who can deal damage and apply Electro while off-field. Additionally, Ineffa's Habilidad Elemental can also provide a shield. Her Habilidad definitiva also provides an Maestría Elemental buff based on a portion of Ineffa's ATK (her A4 talent). Birgitta stays on-field longer than both of Ineffa's Habilidad Elemental and Habilidad definitiva individual cooldowns, meaning that Birgitta has 100% field uptime.

role.en: Off-Field DPS & Buff and Heal Support
role.es: DPS fuera de campo y soporte de buffs y curación

notes.en: Linnea is a potent support for Geo units, providing Off-Field Damage with her companion Lumi, Lunar-Crystallize DMG when Moondrifts are present, and also providing Geo Resistance shredding and teamwide healing. In addition, when Ascendant Gleam is active, Lumi can also boost the team's Elemental Mastery, and further amplifies the Geo Resistance shredding. Linnea can feed Lumi into her Ultimate Power form to execute the Million Ton Crush, a huge Lunar-Crystallize DMG nuke.
notes.es: Linnéa is a potent support for Geo units, providing Off-Field Damage with her companion Lumi, Cristalización lunar DMG when Moondrifts are present, and also providing Geo Resistance shredding and teamwide healing. In addition, when Ascendant Gleam is active, Lumi can also boost the team's Maestría Elemental, and further amplifies the Geo Resistance shredding. Linnéa can feed Lumi into her Ultimate Power form to execute the Million Ton Crush, a huge Cristalización lunar DMG nuke.

notes.en: DPS Neuvillette centers around using his Charged Attacks to deal damage. Weapon options similar to Prototype Amber can be used better by other characters, so it's not recommended to pull or upgrade these weapons just for Neuvillette. Marechaussee’s Charged Attack DMG% and hefty CRIT Rate make it Neuvillette’s BiS by a sizable margin. Furthermore, stacks on the 4-piece effect are obtained quickly due to the HP drain from Neuvillette’s Charged Attack.It is highly recommended to farm or strongbox this set.
notes.es: DPS Neuvillette centers around using his Ataque Cargados to deal damage. Weapon options similar to Prototipo Ámbar can be used better by other characters, so it's not recommended to pull or upgrade these weapons just for Neuvillette.

notes.en: Xiao is a Hypercarry that is centered around plunge attacks. Due to his expensive Burst, Xiao usually requires a high amount of Energy Recharge and/or at least one Anemo battery (Sucrose, [C6] Faruzan, Xianyun) on his team to help him recharge his Burst. Xiao's Optimal Skill Rotation: E E Q Plunge Combo

notes.en: Gaming can reliably Vaporize or Melt most, if not all, of his Skill-enhanced Plunge Attacks. This allows him to deal high amounts of damage during his Burst's Wushou state.

notes.en: Wriothesley as a Stellar-Conduct DPS uses his enhanced Normal Attack and Charged Attack to deal Stellar-Conduct DMG. In this role, he is played with a character that can enable the Stellar Glimmer reactions (i.e. Odette, Cryo Traveler) so he can fully take advantage of his Witch's Revelation Passive. As he only gets his enhanced Charged Attack when he is under 60% HP, it is strongly discouraged to play Wriothesley with a healer.
notes.es: Wriothesley as a Superconductor estelar DPS uses his enhanced Ataque Normal and Ataque Cargado to deal Superconductor estelar DMG. In this role, he is played with a character that can enable the Destello Estelar reactions (i.e. Odette, Cryo Viajero) so he can fully take advantage of his Witch's Revelation Passive. As he only gets his enhanced Ataque Cargado when he is under 60% HP, it is strongly discouraged to play Wriothesley with a healer.

fourPiece.en: If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, after they use an Elemental Skill, they gain "Light's Guidance" for 20s: All nearby party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to the equipping character's Elemental Type. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. DMG Bonuses provided by Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.· When your party has the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, Light's Guidance is upgraded to "Mortal Hymn": All nearby party members gain a 40% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to both the equipping character and the current active party member's Elemental Type instead. If both characters have the same Elemental Type, these bonuses will not stack.
fourPiece.es: Si el portador de este conjunto de artefactos ya ha completado la misión de «Lecciones del Aquelarre», tras usar su Habilidad Elemental, obtendrá el efecto de “guía de la luz celestial”, el cual otorga durante 20 s a todos los personajes cercanos del equipo un 20% de bono de daño del elemento correspondiente al elemento del portador. Este efecto se puede activar incluso cuando el portador de este conjunto está en tu equipo pero no en uso. Los bonos de daño otorgados por este conjunto de artefactos no se pueden acumular con los de otro conjunto del mismo tipo.·Si el equipo tiene el efecto de “taumaturgia: rito secreto”, mejora el efecto de guía de la luz celestial a “himno del mundo terrenal”, de manera que, además del bono correspondiente al tipo elemental del portador, todos los personajes cercanos del equipo también obtendrán un bono de daño correspondiente al elemento de tu personaje en uso del equipo, y ambos Bonos de Daño Elemental pasarán a ser del 40%. Los bonos de daño del mismo tipo elemental no se pueden acumular.

role.es: Soporte de buffs y DPS fuera de campo

notes.en: This playstyle uses Durin's Purity form to decrease the Elemental Resistance of Pyro, Dendro, Electro, Anemo and Geo when reactions with those elements and Pyro occur. Purity form is Durin's default Burst, it can be swapped to (if in Denial form) via an E E Q rotation.
notes.es: This playstyle uses Durin's Purity form to decrease the Elemental Resistance of Pyro, Dendro, Electro, Anemo and Geo when reactions with those elements and Pyro occur. Purity form is Durin's default Habilidad definitiva, it can be swapped to (if in Denial form) via an E E Q rotation.

notes.en: Mona can use her Burst to apply the Omen debuff on enemies and allow teammates to deal more damage. This is most commonly seen in Freeze teams. Mona's main role on a Freeze team is to provide Omen debuff from her Burst as it is extendable via Freeze mechanics. Note that you must apply Cryo before casting Mona's Burst for the extension to happen. Omen Freeze extension can be done by reapplying Cryo and Hydro aura consistently (this can be done with Cryo / Hydro infused Venti Burst + on-field Cryo / Hydro aura).
notes.es: Mona can use her Habilidad definitiva to apply the Omen debuff on enemies and allow teammates to deal more damage. This is most commonly seen in Congelación teams. Mona's main role on a Congelación team is to provide Omen debuff from her Habilidad definitiva as it is extendable via Congelación mechanics. Note that you must apply Cryo before casting Mona's Habilidad definitiva for the extension to happen. Omen Congelación extension can be done by reapplying Cryo and Hydro aura consistently (this can be done with Cryo / Hydro infused Venti Habilidad definitiva + on-field Cryo / Hydro aura).

notes.en: Nicole is a potent Support that provides both a shield and a sizeable Flat ATK buff to the entire team. The party member on field also gets an additional ATK buff after 3 seconds or instantly if they are a Hexerei character. Nicole needs 4000 Attack to reach her full Attack buff.
notes.es: Nicole is a potent Support that provides both a shield and a sizeable ATQ buff to the entire team. The party member on field also gets an additional ATK buff after 3 seconds or instantly if they are a Hexerei character. Nicole needs 4000 Attack to reach her full Attack buff.

notes.en: Prune is a support that relies on triggering the Swirl reaction to buff characters. Triggering Swirl will convert her Banehunter Oathhammer (Skill) into the element she Swirls, and as long as her A4 talent is unlocked, hitting opponents with a converted Banehunter Oathhammer or her Burst will activate the Tolling Rally effect, which will provide DMG buffs to the team based on Prune's ATK. In addition, when a Hexerei character under Tolling Rally triggers a reaction, Prune gains an ATK% boost, and if that reaction was Swirl, the triggering character also gains an ATK% boost. Prune's [C1] let's her restore 2 Energy every 1.8 seconds whenever a converted Banehunter Oathhammer hits opponents. How much total energy she can restore depends how often Prune is able to trigger Swirl during the duration of her Burst. Prune's [C6] increases her Burst duration by 4 seconds.
